panels.description: One row per GPU. Utilization is the most recent sample; Pod is the workload currently attributed to the GPU (blank when idle).
panels.title: GPU Inventory
GPU Utilization
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL — fraction of time the GPU was busy.

panels.title: Memory Copy Utilization
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL — fraction of time memory copy engines were busy.

panels.title: Encoder / Decoder Utilization
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_ENC_UTIL / DCGM_FI_DEV_DEC_UTIL — NVENC/NVDEC video engine utilization.

panels.title: GPU Utilization by Pod
panels.description: Workload attribution from the exporter's Kubernetes mapping. The ServiceMonitor scrapes with honorLabels: false, so the workload's namespace/pod arrive as exported_namespace/exported_pod (plain namespace/pod are the dcgm-exporter pod itself). Series with an empty pod are idle GPUs.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP / DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP. Memory temp is only exported on GPUs with HBM.

panels.title: Power Draw
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE (instantaneous) and the 5m average derived from the DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION counter (mJ/s ÷ 1000 = W).

panels.title: SM Clock
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK (MHz, scaled to Hz for display). Sustained low clocks under load indicate thermal or power throttling.

panels.title: Memory Clock
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK (MHz, scaled to Hz for display).

panels.title: PCIe Replays (5m increase)
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER — link-level retries. A non-zero rate indicates PCIe signal-integrity problems.

panels.title: XID Errors
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS — value is the most recent XID error code (0 = none). Any non-zero value deserves a look at the node's kernel log.

panels.title: Remapped Memory Rows
panels.description: Row-remapping counters (A100+ / HBM GPUs only). Growing uncorrectable remaps or any remap failure means the GPU needs service.
